row.notes: myteam-g1: Loader that reads an array of 0x5c-byte entries (+0x460) per level from config/save, containing secretUpgradeLevel and simultaneousUpgradeLevel. Returns 0x57/0x58 error codes on missing/wrong type.

verify.notes: V9644 It is a save loader of recognitionDriverData (driverStatId, recognition totals, bonuses, secret meeting lists) with 0x5c-byte entries at +0x460; secretUpgradeLevel/simultaneousUpgradeLevel are only some inner fields, not per-level config.
